paragraph: [The AGT's taxpayer register held 11,173,618 taxpayers in January 2024](<https://www.expansao.co.ao/angola/detalhe/apenas-2-em-cada-10-cidadaos-tem-oficialmente-numero-de-identificacao-fiscal-61658.html>). [Angola's SEPE e-services portal lists a free online service, 'Consulta de NIF'](<https://sepe.gov.ao/catalogo/eservicos>). In September 2025 the Secretary of State for Justice said [the civil identification systems are synchronised with the tax administration, the AGT](<https://pti.ao/ministerio-da-justica-reitera-aposta-nas-tic-para-modernizar-e-simplificar-servicos/>), so the identity card number also serves as the taxpayer number. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says the taxpayer number is shared with business registration or customs. Operating would need the taxpayer number issued at business registration or used by customs, one number for both.

[The revenue office OBR said that from 4 August 2026 all new taxpayer registrations are made online on its e-KORI platform](<https://abpinfo.bi/2026/08/06/e-kori-toutes-les-nouvelles-demandes-dimmatriculation-desormais-en-ligne-a-partir-du-4-aout/>). [The OBR confirms e-KORI entered service that day](<https://obr.bi/index.php/e-kori>). In the last twelve months it also told owners in July 2026 to [declare land tax online on its UMUTANGAKORI II platform](<https://www.obr.bi/index.php/communiques/2612-communique-declaration-et-paiement-en-ligne-de-l-impot-foncier>). No earlier registration position has been found. No source found since November 2023 says the taxpayer number is shared with business registration or customs. Operating would need the taxpayer number issued at business registration or used by customs, one number for both.

[The tax directorate's 2025 guide says the IFU is generated instantly on its e-services portal](<https://e-services.impots.bj/_espaces/FACILE/domain/engine/application/guides/guide-utilisateur-adhesion-et-connexion.pdf>). [ANIP said in September 2025 that the IFU comes from the same civil-status database as the identity card](<https://beninwebtv.bj/affichage-de-la-liste-electorale-provisoire-lanip-lance-la-phase-de-verification/>). In the last twelve months the platform was cited and not changed. [La Marina reported in November 2026 that it has issued an IFU within 24 hours since December 2021](<https://lamarina.bj/2026/11/06/benin-8-millions-de-dollars-pour-renforcer-linterconnexion-des-fichiers-fiscaux-et-didentification/>). Only [a 2020 government guide](<https://www.gouv.bj/doc/158/download>) says the IFU is issued at business registration. Operating would need that shown by a source from the past three years.

[The Direction Générale des Impôts published a FAQ on 17 October 2023](<https://dgi.bf/faq-immatriculation-des-contribuables/>) saying taxpayers are registered in the register of taxpayers or the software for the single financial identifier (IFU). The FAQ says customs clearance for foreign trade needs an IFU. In the last twelve months, [the business-creation centre CEFORE said in November 2026 that one fee paid online covers business registration and the IFU](<https://creerentreprise.me.bf/>). No source found since November 2023 ties the IFU to the national ID. Mature would need the taxpayer number to be the national ID number or checked against the national ID.

No stage is set. Nothing found since October 2023 says whether taxpayers in the Central African Republic are registered on computer. No source found says a computerised taxpayer register or a new taxpayer number is being built or rolled out. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Absent would need a source from the past three years saying taxpayers are registered on paper or not registered.

[The Finance Ministry communique of 10 April 2026, as reported by LeFisk, says the DGI's ATOM platform has been in service since 1 July 2026](<https://lefisk.cm/blog/atom-dgi-cameroun-immatriculation-fiscale-guide-complet>). [It is mandatory for all new registrations and issues the NIU taxpayer number online](<https://lefisk.cm/blog/atom-dgi-cameroun-immatriculation-fiscale-guide-complet>). In the last twelve months, [LeFisk reports that ATOM is progressively replacing the Harmony platform](<https://lefisk.cm/blog/atom-dgi-cameroun-immatriculation-fiscale-guide-complet>). No source found since November 2023 says the NIU is shared with business registration or customs. Operating would need the taxpayer number issued at business registration or used by customs, one number for both.

[In December 2025 the tax directorate (DGI) said registration for the taxpayer number, the Numéro d'Identification Fiscale (NIF), is free](<https://dgi.gouv.cd/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/COMMUNIQUE%CC%81-OFFICIEL-N%C2%B001_061.pdf>). [Applicants request the NIF online through the e-NIF platform, or else at tax offices](<https://dgi.gouv.cd/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/COMMUNIQUE%CC%81-OFFICIEL-N%C2%B001_061.pdf>). The same notice lists the Guichet Unique de Création d'Entreprise among the places to request a NIF. That notice dates from the last twelve months, and no earlier position has been found. No source found since November 2023 says the NIF is tied to the national ID. Mature would need the taxpayer number to be the national ID number or checked against it.

[The NIU project coordinator said in October 2025 that the NIU file is the tax directorate's taxpayer file](<https://www.finances.gouv.cg/en/node/4803>). [Commercial firms request the NIU through the business creation agency ACPCE](<https://www.finances.gouv.cg/en/node/4803>). [An order of 12 October 2022 makes it compulsory for customs duty declarations and payments](<https://www.finances.gouv.cg/en/node/4803>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says the NIU is the national ID number or is checked against the national ID. Mature would need the taxpayer number to be the national ID number or checked against it.

In 2026 [the GOV.CV portal says a person can request a tax identification number (NIF) online](<https://www.gov.cv/nif-pessoa-singular>). [The Empresa no Dia platform (PEO) includes the NIF in its company-creation package](<https://peo.gov.cv/sobre-nos>), with commercial registration and social security enrolment. Both pages date from the last twelve months, and no earlier position has been found. No source found since November 2023 says the taxpayer number is tied to the national ID. Mature would need the taxpayer number to be the national ID number or checked against it.

No stage is set. [In January 2026 Djibouti's business-creation guide said the Guichet Unique passes the registration file to the DGI automatically](<https://entreprendre.dj/portals/g2b/guide>). [The DGI then assigns the NIF as a step of business creation](<https://entreprendre.dj/portals/g2b/guide>). The guide dates from the last twelve months, and no earlier position has been found. Nothing found since October 2023 says whether taxpayers are registered on computer. Establishing would need taxpayer numbers issued from a computerised register in service, online or at offices.

As at October 2026, [the Direction Générale des Impôts says the NIF taxpayer number is obtained online through the online tax registration and NIF authentication portal](<https://www.mfdgi.gov.dz/fr/professionnels/nouveau-contribuable-fr/ouvrir-dossier-fiscal>). [The commercial register's company-creation portal lets a founder register once online with every administration concerned](<https://sidjilcom-entreprise.cnrc.dz/acceuil>). [The founder receives one common identification number within three days](<https://sidjilcom-entreprise.cnrc.dz/acceuil>). No earlier position has been found, and both pages date from the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the NIF is tied to the national ID. Mature would need the taxpayer number to be the national ID number or checked against it.

No stage is set. Nothing found since October 2023 says whether taxpayers in Egypt are registered on computer. No source found says a computerised taxpayer register or a new taxpayer number is being built or rolled out. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Absent would need a source from the past three years saying taxpayers are registered on paper or not registered.

[In May 2024 the research centre ICTD said the ministry was already using biometric data to register taxpayer numbers (TINs)](<https://ictd.ac/general/ethiopia-national-digital-id-breakthrough-tax-system-transformation/>). [ICTD says each new TIN has been connected to a Fayda number since December 2023](<https://ictd.ac/general/ethiopia-national-digital-id-breakthrough-tax-system-transformation/>). In the last twelve months, [in May 2026 the ID programme said Fayda is mandatory for new TINs and over 5 million older ones have been matched](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T1-2-1-Ethiopia-FINAL.pdf>). No source found says the TIN is issued at business registration or used by customs. Operating would need the taxpayer number issued at business registration or used by customs, one number for both.

[In October 2025 the Direction Générale des Impôts' e-tax guide said taxpayers can start registration online](<https://e-tax.dgi.ga/_espaces/ECONTRIBUABLEDGIGA/domain/engine/application/guides/guide-utilisateur-adhesion-et-connexion.pdf>). [They use the 'Je m'immatricule' button](<https://e-tax.dgi.ga/_espaces/ECONTRIBUABLEDGIGA/domain/engine/application/guides/guide-utilisateur-adhesion-et-connexion.pdf>). [Enrolled taxpayers hold a taxpayer number (NIF)](<https://e-tax.dgi.ga/_espaces/ECONTRIBUABLEDGIGA/domain/engine/application/guides/guide-utilisateur-adhesion-et-connexion.pdf>), and DGI agents complete the checks at a tax office. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since November 2023 says the NIF is shared with business registration or customs. Operating would need the taxpayer number issued at business registration or used by customs, one number for both.

In September 2025 the identity authority's head said [the Ghana Card already serves as the tax number](<https://atlfmnews.com/nia-to-integrate-student-database-with-ghana-card-for-easy-access/>). The Ghana Revenue Authority says [the Ghana Card PIN replaced the TIN it used to issue](<https://gra.gov.gh/tin/>) from 1 April 2021. In the last twelve months, in May 2026 he added that [a child registered for the card gets a tax number automatically](<https://gna.org.gh/2026/05/nia-registers-over-32000-children-in-volta-oti-regions/>). The authority's [TIN Centre sits at the Registrar-General's Department as a one-stop shop](<https://gra.gov.gh/tin/>). No source says what share of taxpayers hold a Ghana Card PIN as their tax number.

[The Direction generale des impots announced on 21 June 2025 that tax registration in Guinea is done exclusively online](<https://www.guinee360.com/22/06/2025/immatriculation-en-ligne-la-direction-nationale-des-impots-fixe-les-regles/>). [APIP says its one-stop shop issues the NIF tax number with the RCCM at business creation](<https://apip.gov.gn/guichet-unique-de-la-creation-dentreprise/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since November 2023 says the NIF is tied to the national ID. Mature would need the taxpayer number to be the national ID number or checked against the national ID.

[The Gambia Revenue Authority's 2024 brochure describes TIN registration on its web portal, with an instant acknowledgement and a printable certificate](<https://www.gra.gm/download-file/235e4301-48f2-11ef-b086-029254d29bb1>). [It lists imports and exports among the uses of the TIN, alongside filing and paying tax](<https://www.gra.gm/download-file/235e4301-48f2-11ef-b086-029254d29bb1>). [In October 2025 the authority said ITAS is to integrate with the national identification database to identify taxpayers](<https://standard.gm/gra-introduces-itas-system-to-stakeholders/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since November 2023 says that integration is in service. Mature would need the taxpayer number to be the national ID number or checked against it.

[DGCI Instruction 25/2025, of 3 December 2025, says the NIF may be issued only through a module of the tax directorate's Kontaktu system](<https://kontaktu.mef.gw/instructions>). [The company formalities centre (CFE) says a DGCI agent validates the data after commercial registration](<https://web.archive.org/web/20260311133337/https://cfe.gw/numero-de-identificacao-fiscal/>). Its page, dated 2026, says the NIF is issued as part of company registration. Both sources date from the last twelve months, and no earlier position has been found. No source found since November 2023 says the NIF is tied to the national ID. Mature would need the taxpayer number to be the national ID number or checked against it.

[In August 2026 the government press office reported that the Consejo Interministerial took up a draft decree on the Número de Identificación Fiscal (NIF)](<https://www.guineaecuatorialpress.com/noticias/el_consejo_interministerial_analiza_nuevas_medidas_para_reforzar_el_empleo_la_fiscalidad_y_la_cooperacion_internacional>). [The decree sets a new NIF codification](<https://www.guineaecuatorialpress.com/noticias/el_consejo_interministerial_analiza_nuevas_medidas_para_reforzar_el_empleo_la_fiscalidad_y_la_cooperacion_internacional>) covering natural persons, legal persons and entities without legal personality. That draft dates from the last twelve months, and no earlier position has been found. No source found since November 2023 says taxpayer numbers are issued from a computerised register. Establishing would need taxpayer numbers issued from a computerised register in service, online or at offices.

[The Kenya Revenue Authority's release notes of November and December 2025 describe the iTax Taxpayer Registration Module in service](<https://www.kra.go.ke/images/publications/ITAX-ENHANCEMENTS-NOV-DEC-2025.pdf>). [Taxpayers apply for a PIN, check a PIN, amend their profile and register obligations online](<https://www.kra.go.ke/images/publications/ITAX-ENHANCEMENTS-NOV-DEC-2025.pdf>), using the iTax portal, the M-Service app or USSD. The notes date from the last twelve months, and no earlier position has been found. No source found since November 2023 says the PIN is shared with business registration or customs. Operating would need the taxpayer number issued at business registration or used by customs, one number for both.

No stage is set. [In February 2024 the National Identification Registry (NIR) described its API](<https://newspublictrust.com/national-identification-registry-deploys-mobile-teams>), which [connects the Liberia Revenue Authority with new taxpayers wanting a TIN](<https://newspublictrust.com/national-identification-registry-deploys-mobile-teams>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. Nothing found since October 2023 says whether taxpayers are registered on computer, or that the TIN is shared with business registration or customs. Establishing would need taxpayer numbers issued from a computerised register in service, online or at offices.

[Revenue Services Lesotho says individual taxpayers can register online through eTax to obtain a Taxpayer Identification Number](<https://www.rsl.org.ls/sites/default/files/2025-06/Guide%20on%20Tax%20Registration.pdf>). [Companies obtain the TIN from RSL after registering with the relevant ministries](<https://www.rsl.org.ls/sites/default/files/2025-06/Guide%20on%20Tax%20Registration.pdf>). [Revenue Service Lesotho said every client can register online through its fully implemented e-Taxation system](<https://newsdayonline.co.ls/rsl-implements-e-taxation-system/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since November 2023 says the TIN is shared with business registration or customs. Operating would need the taxpayer number issued at business registration or used by customs, one number for both.

In May 2026 the tax directorate [launched an online platform, Taxation on Digital Services, for foreign providers of remote services](<https://fr.hespress.com/489385-publicite-meta-applique-la-tva-au-maroc-des-octobre.html>). The platform rests on [decree 2.25.862 of 27 November 2025](<https://ecoactu.ma/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/decret-pour-la-TVA-sur-les-services-a-distance-au-Maroc-fournis-par-des-prestataires-non-residents-Art-115-Bis-du-CGI.pdf>), which says [the administration issues non-resident providers a tax identification number electronically](<https://ecoactu.ma/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/decret-pour-la-TVA-sur-les-services-a-distance-au-Maroc-fournis-par-des-prestataires-non-residents-Art-115-Bis-du-CGI.pdf>). Both date from the last twelve months, and no earlier position has been found. No source found since October 2023 shows the register covering other taxpayers. Operating would need the taxpayer number issued at business registration or used by customs, one number for both.

[The tax directorate says NIF applicants fill in an online form on NIFONLINE and get a reference](<https://hetraonline.impots.mg/accueil/papier_inscri>). [They then present originals at their tax office](<https://hetraonline.impots.mg/accueil/papier_inscri>). [In October 2017 a finance ministry arrete made the online tax number the single identifier across the ministry](<https://textes.lexxika.com/lois-malagasy/arrete-n25508-2017-du-12-octobre-2016-fixant-le-numero-dimmatriculation-fiscale-en-ligne-nif-online-comme-etant-lidentifiant-unique-utilise-par-tous-les-departements-au-sein-du-ministere-d/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since November 2023 says the NIF is shared with business registration or customs. Operating would need the taxpayer number issued at business registration or used by customs, one number for both.

No stage is set. Nothing found since October 2023 says whether taxpayers in Mali are registered on computer. No source found says a computerised taxpayer register or a new taxpayer number is being built or rolled out. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Absent would need a source from the past three years saying taxpayers are registered on paper or not registered.

[In September 2026 CEDSIF, the state's finance systems centre, listed e-Tributação as the tax system for domestic taxes](<https://www.cedsif.gov.mz/cedsifportal/?page_id=81>). [It includes a module for registering the taxpayer number, the NUIT](<https://www.cedsif.gov.mz/cedsifportal/?page_id=81>). [The tax authority's FAQ says the NUIT must be used for all taxes, including customs duties](<http://www.at.gov.mz/por/Perguntas-Frequentes2/NUIT>). In the last twelve months, [in July 2026 the government was advancing a new integrated tax management system](<https://aimnews.org/2026/07/22/governo-avanca-com-sistema-integrado-para-modernizar-gestao-tributaria/>). No source found since October 2023 says the NUIT is tied to the national ID. Mature would need the taxpayer number to be the national ID number or checked against it.

[Since 4 April 2025 a tax registration can be obtained through the APIM 'Mes services' portal](<https://ami.mr/fr/archives/268316>). [Since April 2025 the APIM portal has given three registrations in one procedure at company creation](<https://ami.mr/fr/archives/268316>): the commerce register, tax registration and social security affiliation. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since November 2023 says the taxpayer number is tied to the national ID. Mature would need the taxpayer number to be the national ID number or checked against it.

In 2026 [the Mauritius Revenue Authority (MRA) said it issues a Tax Account Number (TAN) at registration in its databases](<https://www.oecd.org/content/dam/oecd/en/topics/policy-issue-focus/aeoi/mauritius-tin.pdf>). The same statement says it [allocates a TAN to entities and business individuals as soon as they receive their Business Registration Number](<https://www.oecd.org/content/dam/oecd/en/topics/policy-issue-focus/aeoi/mauritius-tin.pdf>). That statement dates from the last twelve months, and no earlier position has been found. No source found since November 2023 says the TAN is tied to the national ID. Mature would need the taxpayer number to be the national ID number or checked against it.

[On 4 August 2025 the Commissioner General made the Tax Administration (Electronic System) Rules, 2025](<https://media.malawilii.org/media/legislation/15001/source_file/0deaa96755badce1/tax-administration-electronic-system-rules-2025.pdf>). [They require taxpayers to be registered electronically](<https://media.malawilii.org/media/legislation/15001/source_file/0deaa96755badce1/tax-administration-electronic-system-rules-2025.pdf>), and require the Commissioner General to keep an electronic register of taxpayers. [In September 2019 Nyasa Times reported that the revenue authority's Msonkho Online system lets taxpayers register, file and pay online](<https://www.nyasatimes.com/mra-immigration-join-forces-to-enhance-tax-laws-permits-compliance/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since November 2023 says the TPIN is shared with business registration or customs. Operating would need the taxpayer number issued at business registration or used by customs, one number for both.

[In a notice of 1 April 2026 the Namibia Revenue Agency (NamRA) told traders they could apply for a Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) online](<https://www.namra.org.na/documents/cms/uploaded/public-notice-asycudaworld-golive-date-extended-e62d0a7fe7.pdf>). [NamRA says the TIN it issues is mandatory on every customs declaration in ASYCUDAWorld from 1 April 2026](<https://www.namra.org.na/documents/cms/uploaded/public-notice--mandatory-tin-on-asycudaworld--9-dec-2025-7d1548a64e.pdf>). [Declarations without a valid TIN are rejected automatically](<https://www.namra.org.na/documents/cms/uploaded/public-notice--mandatory-tin-on-asycudaworld--9-dec-2025-7d1548a64e.pdf>). Both notices date from the last twelve months, and no earlier position has been found. No source found since October 2023 says the TIN is tied to the national ID. Mature would need the taxpayer number to be the national ID number or checked against it.

No stage is set. Nothing found since October 2023 says whether taxpayers in Niger are registered on computer. No source found says a computerised taxpayer register or a new taxpayer number is being built or rolled out. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Absent would need a source from the past three years saying taxpayers are registered on paper or not registered.

[The Nigeria Revenue Service article says a system-generated 13-digit Tax ID is automatically generated when a new company registers](<https://nrsportal.ng/corporate-tax-in-2026-using-cac-numbers-as-nrs-identifiers/>). [TechCabal says the Tax Identification Number is generated from the National Identification Number for individuals](<https://techcabal.com/2026/01/12/nigeria-crypto-tax-tin-nin/>). In the last twelve months, [from 1 January 2026 the NRS database is integrated with the CAC, so no separate TIN application is needed](<https://nrsportal.ng/corporate-tax-in-2026-using-cac-numbers-as-nrs-identifiers/>). No earlier dated position has been found. The latest dated fact is that integration of 1 January 2026.

[The Rwanda Revenue Authority (RRA) tells property owners to log in to its website with their TIN and password](<https://www.rra.gov.rw/en/home?tx_news_pi1%5Baction%5D=detail&tx_news_pi1%5Bcontroller%5D=News&tx_news_pi1%5Bnews%5D=2415&cHash=ed34adc0d34fabbccdf4972aa88585f1>), under a 2024 notice. [Its 2026 registration page says the RRA issues TINs at all its offices](<https://www.rra.gov.rw/en/domestic-tax-services/registration-de-registration/default-title>). [The same page says firms registering through the Rwanda Development Board (RDB) portal get a single TIN](<https://www.rra.gov.rw/en/domestic-tax-services/registration-de-registration/default-title>). That page dates from the last twelve months, and no earlier position has been found. No source found since November 2023 says the TIN is tied to the national ID. Mature would need the taxpayer number to be the national ID number or checked against it.

No stage is set. [In April 2026 the Sudan Taxation Chamber said it issues each taxpayer a single tax identification number on registration](<https://tax.gov.sd/en/tax-procedures/>). [The one number serves all types of taxes, including customs duties](<https://tax.gov.sd/en/tax-procedures/>). That page dates from the last twelve months, and no earlier position has been found. Nothing found since October 2023 says whether taxpayers are registered on computer. Establishing would need taxpayer numbers issued from a computerised register in service, online or at offices.

[The tax directorate, DGID, lets taxpayers register online through its SENTAX portal](<https://www.dgid.sn/sentax>). [A finance ministry order lets foreign suppliers register online from 1 April 2024](<https://www.dgid.sn/storage/uploads/2024/07/Order-GTC-355-Digital-VAT-DEFINITIVE-VERSION.pdf>), and they receive a NINEA tax identification number. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says customs use the taxpayer number, or that it is issued when a business registers. Operating would need the taxpayer number issued at business registration or used by customs, one number for both.

No stage is set. Nothing found since October 2023 says whether taxpayers in Sierra Leone are registered on computer. No source found says a computerised taxpayer register or a new taxpayer number is being built or rolled out. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Absent would need a source from the past three years saying taxpayers are registered on paper or not registered.

[In November 2026 an opinion piece said ITAS, the revenue authority's new platform, will bring taxpayer registration and a single record of every taxpayer onto one system](<https://www.hiiraan.com/op4/2026/Nov/206761/feisal_mohamed_hashi_the_vision_behind_somalias_revenue_reforms.aspx>). [Its rollout is due to begin at the end of 2026](<https://www.hiiraan.com/op4/2026/Nov/206761/feisal_mohamed_hashi_the_vision_behind_somalias_revenue_reforms.aspx>). That piece dates from the last twelve months. [In August 2024 the Deputy Minister of Finance announced the coming launch of a taxpayer number linked to the national ID system](<https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2024/Aug/197694/somalia_introduces_modern_digital_identification_to_enhance_banking_services.aspx>), and no source found says it has been launched. Establishing would need taxpayer numbers issued from a computerised register in service, online or at offices.

[The government eServices portal says all taxpayers can apply online for a Taxpayer Identification Number on eTax](<https://www.eservices.gov.ss/>). [The portal still offered the service in November 2026](<https://accounts.eservices.gov.ss/mdas>). In the last twelve months, [on 12 June 2026 the authority told taxpayers to update their details in its electronic TIN system](<https://radioyei.org/news/business/economy/revenue-authority-hunts-unregistered-businesses/>). No earlier position has been found. No source found since November 2023 says the TIN is shared with business registration or customs. Operating would need the taxpayer number issued at business registration or used by customs, one number for both.

No stage is set. [In 2024 the Eswatini Trade Portal said companies dealing in imports and exports must register in ASYCUDA](<https://eswatinitradeportal.com/index.php?id=25&r=searchProcedure%2Fview1>). [They must upload their TIN registration there](<https://eswatinitradeportal.com/index.php?id=25&r=searchProcedure%2Fview1>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. Nothing found since October 2023 says whether taxpayers are registered on computer. Establishing would need taxpayer numbers issued from a computerised register in service, online or at offices.

[In 2025 the Seychelles e-Service Gateway offered an online TIN registration form for companies](<https://eservice.egov.sc/TinRegistration/pages/RegistrationForCompany.aspx>). [The form covers presumptive tax, VAT, employer, business tax and excise registration](<https://eservice.egov.sc/TinRegistration/pages/RegistrationForCompany.aspx>), and requires the contact person's 11-digit National Identity Number. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the taxpayer number is shared with business registration or customs. Operating would need the taxpayer number issued at business registration or used by customs, one number for both.

[PwC states that taxpayers can apply on the E.Tax platform, online or at an office, for a certificate of tax identification number (NIF)](<https://taxsummaries.pwc.com/chad/corporate/significant-developments>). [Chad's customs directorate says every importer, exporter and customs agent needs a valid NIF, required on every declaration](<https://douanes.td/e-douane/e-paiement/>). [The SYDONIA World customs system blocks a declaration made without one](<https://douanes.td/e-douane/e-paiement/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the NIF is tied to the national ID. Mature would need the taxpayer number to be the national ID number or checked against it.

[On 18 December 2023 the OTR presented an online service at nif.otr.tg](<https://www.otr.tg/index.php/fr/1290-l-otr-innove-la-creation-du-nif-et-le-payement-de-la-tvm-desormais-disponible-en-ligne.html>). [In 2025 the OTR said individuals can create a NIF particulier online or at tax offices](<https://www.otr.tg/index.php/fr/blog/otr-actu/598-magazine-otr-actu-n-18-janvier-juin-2025/file.html>). The same source says the individual NIF is required for customs clearance of personal goods. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since November 2023 says the NIF is tied to the national ID. Mature would need the taxpayer number to be the national ID number or checked against it.

In October 2026 the report on the 2027 State budget bill said the tax administration [launched an online platform for the declaration of existence](<https://www.webmanagercenter.com/2026/10/27/575585/tunisie-la-digitalisation-fiscale-permet-deconomiser-6-000-journees-de-travail/>). A taxpayer can obtain a tax identification card through it. In 2026 the National Business Register [said the unique identifier of each registered firm is its matricule fiscal](<https://home.registre-entreprises.tn/le-registre-national-des-entreprises-vers-le-full-digital/>). Both date from the last twelve months, and no earlier position has been found. No source found since October 2023 ties the tax number to the national ID. Mature would need the taxpayer number to be the national ID number or checked against it.

[The identity authority NIDA lists online TIN registration among the services run through its consent-based identity check](<https://www.id4africa.com/2025/files/PS1-S1-2-Tanzania-final.pdf>). [By September 2026, 8.4 million TINs had been registered using national ID numbers, NIDA said](<https://nida.go.tz/uploads/speeches/20260911123900_doc.pdf>). In the last twelve months, [the Revenue Authority's trainers said in January 2026 that IDRAS, the new domestic tax system, would start on 9 February 2026](<https://www.mwananchi.co.tz/mw/habari/kitaifa/mfumo-wa-idras-kuunganishwa-na-ai-kulinda-taarifa-binafsi-5339964>). Nothing found says whether the TIN is issued at business registration or used by customs. Operating would need the taxpayer number issued at business registration or used by customs, one number for both.

[The Uganda Revenue Authority (URA) held about 5.7 million records at 30 June 2026, the finance ministry says](<https://softpower.ug/nin-tin-transition-will-not-automatically-create-tax-liability-lugoloobi/>). In the last twelve months, [Cabinet approved on 31 August 2026 the change making the national ID number the tax number for individuals](<https://mulengeranews.com/minister-musasizi-explains-why-nin-is-to-be-used-as-tin-as-icpau-commits-to-enforce-ai-adoption-in-accountancy-sector/>). [By 30 September 2026, 2.13 million of 5.41 million individual records were linked to a NIN](<https://ugbusiness.com/2026/10/economy/more-than-3m-tax-records-await-nin-match-before-login-switch>). In September 2026 URA said firms will get a registry number as their tax identifier. That change is still to come. No source says the tax number is now issued at business registration or used by customs. Operating would need the taxpayer number issued at business registration or used by customs, one number for both.

[In October 2026 SARS said its Client Information System was implemented in 2014](<https://www.sars.gov.za/client-segments/client-information-system/>). [Taxpayers register for and maintain tax and customs registrations in one consolidated profile](<https://www.sars.gov.za/client-segments/client-information-system/>). That page dates from the last twelve months, and no earlier position has been found. No source found since November 2023 says one taxpayer number is shared with business registration or customs. Operating would need the taxpayer number issued at business registration or used by customs, one number for both.

[The ZRA says its upgraded TaxOnline system, rolled out on 5 January 2020, auto-approves all TPIN registrations](<https://www.zra.org.zm/taxonline-enhanced-features/>). Operating would need the taxpayer number issued at business registration or used by customs, one number for both.
